<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): int|string {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "BOOL;";
            return true;
        }
        if ($incoming === "text") {
            $incoming = false;
            return "0012";
        }
        return 7;
    }
};
$reverse = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): string|int {
        if ($incoming === "nil") {
            echo "NULL;";
            return null;
        }
        if ($incoming === "text") { return "kept"; }
        return 9;
    }
};
$selector = "text";
echo $reader->$selector === "0012" ? "STRING;" : "BAD_STRING;";
echo $reader->integer === 7 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo $reverse->text;
echo ";";
$reverse->number;
$firstDestination = 42;
try {
    $firstDestination = $reader->bad === 7;
} catch (TypeError $firstFailure) {
    echo $firstFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
$secondDestination = 24;
try {
    $secondDestination = $reverse->nil === 9;
} catch (TypeError $secondFailure) {
    echo $secondFailure->getMessage();
    echo ";";
}
echo $firstDestination === 42 ? "KEEP1;" : "BAD_STORE1;";
echo $secondDestination === 24 ? "KEEP2;" : "BAD_STORE2;";
echo $selector === "text" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
